name: Marrakesh
summary: Marrakech seduces with the bustle of the Jemaa el-Fnaa square and the labyrinth of the medina, but also offers a quiet life in the riads converted into coworking spaces of Gueliz. With a cost of living among the lowest on the nomadic circuit and direct flights of less than 3 hours from much of Europe, it is an increasingly popular base for working remotely without giving up culture or budget.
